changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO stretchy_report_parameter(report_id,parameter_id,report_parameter_name) SELECT r.id,p.id,'clientId' FROM stretchy_report r CROSS JOIN stretchy_parameter p WHERE r.report_name IN ('KYCNaturalPerson','KYCLegalPerson') AND p.parameter_name='DefaultClient' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stretchy_report_parameter rp WHERE rp.report_id=r.id AND rp.report_parameter_name='clientId');
